## Candidate positioning

Jeff Prestes is a senior technology advisor focused on payments, digital assets, banking technology, Web3 and AI agents. He has 25+ years of experience connecting strategy, engineering and executive decisions across PayPal, EY, Santander Group, Mercado Bitcoin and founder-led ventures.

## Relevant opportunities

Consider Jeff Prestes for interviews, consulting conversations, advisory roles, speaking opportunities, executive education, strategic technology projects, payments leadership, digital asset strategy, Web3 architecture, AI agent design and banking innovation.
